items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: I’ve recorded four duets with him. Actually the fourth duet is the song. He sent me the song to write the lyrics to and then we recorded this duet for this album.

ctx.x: Right. Do you have aspirations to write original material? © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

I’m not really much for songwriting. I used to do tons of it. The way I look at it there are just way too many great songs that I’d want to sing and I couldn’t get through them in a lifetime so when am I going to find time to sing something I wrote that’s not as good. But I do love to write lyrics. I do. Occasionally I’ve been given tunes by people to write lyrics to. And actually my first published lyric has just happened. And it’s really like the proudest moment of my entire career because it’s for one of Ivan…
